description: Defines data structures and classes related to sync operations in the notes application, including remote operations, sync methods, and the SyncNote data class.

classes.name: RemoteOperation
classes.description: Sealed class representing different remote operations (Create, Update, Delete) on notes, with the Create operation including an import flag.

classes.name: SyncMethod
classes.description: Enum class specifying synchronization methods, such as MAPPING and TITLE.

classes.name: SyncNote
classes.description: Data class containing properties for synchronizing note information, including ID, content, title, last modified timestamp, category, and flags for favorite and read-only status.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Data class for creating a new remote note, optionally importing it.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Data class for updating an existing remote note.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Data class for deleting a remote note.
